method.name: LoadRecoverableCandidatesAsync
method.summary: Loads a bounded page of recoverable and finalized-cleanup journal candidates, excluding journals requiring operator action or marked failed.
method.param: Inclusive update-time cutoff for the scan.
Exclusive keyset cursor from the previous page, if any.
Maximum number of candidates to return.

method.name: LoadForInstanceAsync
method.summary: Loads publication journal states for one catalog, item, and item instance token.
method.param: Authorized catalog that must own the journals.

method.name: DeleteForInstanceAsync
method.summary: Deletes all publication journals for one catalog, item, and item instance token.
method.param: Authorized catalog that must own the journals.
method.returns: True when one or more matching journals were removed.

method.name: LoadAsync
method.summary: Loads the publication journal for a transfer session in the specified catalog.
method.param: Catalog that must own the journal.
method.returns: The journal, or null when it does not exist.

method.name: GetOrCreateAsync
method.summary: Loads an existing journal or creates the supplied journal when none exists, scoped to the specified catalog.
method.param: Authorized catalog that must match the journal.
method.returns: The existing or newly created journal.

method.name: AdvanceAsync
method.summary: Advances a journal to a publication phase and optionally records an error or integrity result.
method.param: Catalog that must own the journal.

method.name: RecordFailureAsync
method.summary: Records a failed recovery or publication attempt for a journal.
method.param: Catalog that must own the journal.

method.name: DeleteAsync
method.summary: Deletes the journal for a transfer session in the specified catalog.
method.param: Catalog that must own the journal.
method.returns: A task representing the deletion operation.
